title: Taskbar alignment: left (Windows 10 style)
description: Sets the documented TaskbarAl value to 0, which pins the Windows 11 taskbar to the left edge - the Windows 10 style alignment. On Windows 10 the taskbar is always left-aligned and the value does not exist by default; creating it there is harmless and the undo restores the absence exactly. The previous value is captured in a snapshot before the change and restored by per-feature undo (catalog 80).
